title: CNSS D rank-32 generalization forensics
objective: Determine whether rank-32 D failures cluster around carry structure, wraparound, output bits, local input transitions or the held-out partition, without changing any model parameters.
measurements: exact accuracy on train, validation, test and all 256 states
accuracy by carry-event count, carry-chain length and modular wraparound
per-output-bit accuracy and exact error masks
one-input-bit transition consistency against the arithmetic oracle
checkpoint hash, workspace digest and finite-state verification
controls: public report contains aggregate metrics only
interpretation_rule: The audit can localize observed error patterns but cannot establish a new learned capability or replace the 95% individual-competence gate.
